text: かてると　ふんだ　が　だめか！

structure.jp: かてると　ふんだ　が
structure.en: I figured I could win, but

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after a thought shows what was thought or guessed. かてると ふんだ = 'I figured that I could win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる adds 'can'. かてる = 'can win'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a finished statement means 'but'. ふんだ が だめか = 'I figured so, but it's no good, huh'.
